label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: blockers COMPLETE, other edges 3, pool timeouts 85

report.summary: After the 17:20:46 restart the pool shrank to 3 connections with a 250 ms timeout. An idle-in-transaction session holding locks made requests wait, so connections ran out and transfers returned 500/503 or ran slow.

findings.claim: The restart at 17:20:46 cut the pool from 10 to 3 connections and the acquire timeout from 30000 ms to 250 ms.
findings.reason: Runtime config shows the changed poolMaximumSize and poolConnectionTimeoutMs at the restart.

findings.claim: The pool ran out of connections: 85 acquisition timeouts, active reached the max of 3, and pending borrowers appeared.
findings.reason: Pool metrics show timeouts against a configured maximum of 3 and a 250 ms timeout.

findings.claim: An idle-in-transaction session blocked three ledger_app sessions for up to ~2 s between 17:20:50 and 17:23:50, which held connections and exhausted the small pool.
findings.reason: The blocked sessions sit inside the pool-exhaustion period, so they would hold connections up to ~2 s. The blocker's own origin is not shown.

findings.claim: Transfer failures and slowness match the pool exhaustion: 170 of 726 requests failed with 500/503 (24%), and p95 was 2.35 s.
findings.reason: The error volume is similar to the 85 pool timeouts, and the slow tail is similar to the ~2 s lock waits.

findings.claim: The outbox delivery path is healthy and not the cause.
findings.reason: Deliveries all succeeded at ~72 ms, with no failed outbox rows and arrivals matching publications.

limitations: Scrapes have a 10 s gap, counters restarted 3 times, and the 2 s blocker sampling can miss short blocks.
The window has no per-request link between 500/503 errors and pool timeouts, and the idle-in-transaction session's origin is not identified.
E1 (get_request_metrics) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
E2 (get_outbox_stats) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
E5 (get_pool_metrics) is PARTIAL: Scrapes are missing for 10 s of the window (1 gap(s)); values there are unknown, not zero.
next_checks: Find what application or session owns the idle-in-transaction session 77198 and why it holds locks.
Restore poolMaximumSize=10 and a longer connection timeout, then re-check the error rate under the same blocking.

alternatives.reason: 566 deliveries all succeeded in ~72 ms, and the outbox backlog stayed minimal.
alternatives.hypothesis: Consumer or outbox slowness caused the transfer failures.

alternatives.reason: The blocking and the pool shrink overlap in time, and the evidence cannot separate their effects. The old 10-connection pool is not observed under the same blocking.
alternatives.hypothesis: The idle-in-transaction blocker alone caused the failures, without the pool change.

A.rule: a non-ledger_app session blocked ledger_app sessions in 74 samples; 85 pool acquisition timeouts
